name: FU60
comments: Long-acting furosemide 60 mg once a day in the early morning for 1 month, as indistinguishable pills of the Central Pharmacy. Given D0-D30 or D60-D90 in the randomized double-blind crossover, and with hydrochlorothiazide in the open combined regimen D120-D150. Time 0 is the start of each treatment period.
